meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 把你的 cmem.ai 连接信息(同步令牌、用户 ID、SyncHub 网址)写入插件配置,并校验写入结果;令牌不会显示在对话里。配置好后,记忆的保存和回填才可用。
howto.when: 当你说“设置 claude-mem”“连接 cmem”“在 Cowork 里设置云同步”等,或提供 cmem.ai Connect 的同步令牌、用户 ID、SyncHub 网址时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置 claude-mem,同步令牌是 cm_abc123
say.note: 会把令牌写入配置并校验。

say.text: 连接 cmem,这是我的用户 ID 和 SyncHub 地址
say.note: 缺少令牌时,会至少先要令牌。

say.text: 把配对打包成 .plugin,让设置长期保留
say.note: 容器改动只限本次会话,需重新安装。

howto.what_en: This skill takes the user's cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL), writes them into the plugin config, and verifies the write. It never echoes the token in chat. Once paired, hooks can capture and inject memory.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to “set up claude-mem”, “connect cmem”, “set up cloud sync in Cowork”, etc., or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL).

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem, my sync token is cm_abc123
say_en.note: Writes the token into config and checks status.

say_en.text: Connect cmem, here are my user id and SyncHub URL
say_en.note: If the token is missing, it asks for at least the token.

say_en.text: Package the pairing as a .plugin so it survives restart
say_en.note: Edits last only for the session; reinstall needed.
